info.title: Chains API
info.description: Aggregated blockchain chain data from five external sources (TheGraph, Chainlist, Chain ID Network, SLIP-0044, L2BEAT): chain metadata, relations, RPC endpoints and health, L2 scaling, and operator status.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Only the findings about this chain (a chain profile reads these, not the whole report)

parameters.name: x-diagnostics-token
parameters.description: DIAGNOSTICS_TOKEN; required with ?refresh=true

errorMessage.enum: Invalid tag. Allowed: Testnet, L2, Beacon, ZK, Validium, Optimium

get.description: Get chain metadata, optional static research, and native-asset price by chain ID.

200.description: A single chain metadata projection, with optional static research and native-asset price. RPC endpoints and relations have separate routes.

activity.description: Research-time activity assessment, not current responsiveness.

current_availability_checks.description: Optional raw availability evidence, preserved verbatim; not a live probe.

independent_verification.description: Optional raw independent-verification metadata, preserved verbatim.

verification.description: Includes unresolved profiles; these are unverified.

value.description: Publisher value, unchanged. Missing or null does not mean zero.

hardware.description: Static research, including status, notes and sources when no sizing profile was found. All profiles are retained, including unresolved and conditionally required unsized components.

research.description: Detail-only audited research. Optional source metadata is retained at every level. Absent if no research items or hardware research entry exist; omitted from list and search responses.

price.description: Native-asset USD quote, or null when unavailable. Stale quotes retain price and age but null volume and market cap.

schema.description: A single chain metadata projection, with optional static research and native-asset price. RPC endpoints and relations have separate routes.

get.description: Everything a chain profile page shows, in one response: the chain record with price, its relation graph (depth 2), RPC endpoints and their probe results, node clients, client software, hardforks, software updates and maintenance, its status page and its validation findings. A part whose source fails is null and named in `unavailable`. Cached for 30 seconds per chain.

schema.errorMessage: Invalid depth. Must be between 1 and 5

get.description: Ethereum L2 metrics from growthepie for every covered chain (compact), with the all-L2 aggregate.
Freshness of each growthepie file: live or fallback snapshot, fetch time and last error.
Data-availability layers (Ethereum blobs, Celestia, EigenDA): fees, data posted and consumers per span, from growthepie.
ETH supply and issuance rate (latest and last year daily), with supply events, from growthepie.
One chain from growthepie: profile, every fundamental metric (latest, 7d/30d change, daily history), fees, activity, economics, blockspace by category and DA layers used.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Only upgrades touching this chain ID

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Network name or slug (e.g. "Solana Mainnet", "gnosis") — covers networks with no EVM chain ID

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Only forks touching this chain ID

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: upcoming (activation ahead), past (behind), cancelled (a source said so), unscheduled (marked as a fork, no date known)

parameters.name: scheduledOnly
parameters.description: Drop forks with no known activation time. What a calendar wants — distinct from phase, because a fork can be real and announced with no day named yet.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: upgrades: also list ordinary software updates that carried a fork marker (kind "upgrade" — client releases, RPC patches, infra work). Excluded by default; byKind counts both either way.

parameters.name: unplaced
parameters.description: Only forks placed on no chain, each with `unplaced`: the reason (ambiguous, no_network_named, no_matching_chain), the client repositories that reported it and the chains those run. The review queue for fork placement.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Only events touching this chain ID — with type=hardfork, its hardfork history

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma list of hardfork (a consensus fork / network upgrade), software_update (a client version rolled out with no fork, never an incident), maintenance (a provider window naming no software)

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: upcoming, past, cancelled, or unscheduled (no date known)

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only events activating at/after this time (drops undated events)

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only events activating at/before this time; a bare date (YYYY-MM-DD) includes that whole UTC day (drops undated events)

get.description: Raw node/client repository research per chain, for chains-client-feed's registry. Takes no query parameters.
Blockchain client releases and changelog entries from chains-client-feed, newest first, with any hard fork the notes announce (`enrichment.fork`). 503 when the feed is not configured.

parameters.name: fork
parameters.description: true = only releases announcing a fork; false = only those that do not

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Only this repository (`owner/repo` = GitHub, or `github:` / `gitlab:` prefixed)

errorMessage.pattern: since must be an ISO date or date-time

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only releases published at or after this ISO date/time

errorMessage.pattern: until must be an ISO date or date-time

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only releases published at or before this ISO date/time (inclusive; a bare date covers that whole UTC day)

get.description: The latest release of one client repository: version, release link, whether it ships a hard fork, whether the upgrade is mandatory, whether it is a security release (a GitHub advisory naming this version as patched, or the notes) and which CLI flags / config keys it changes, each with the line of the notes that says so. `null` means unknown (not classified yet, no notes), never "no". Stable releases only unless `prerelease=true`; a monorepo lists the newest release of each component in `components`.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: `owner/repo` (GitHub), `github:owner/repo`, `gitlab:owner/repo`, or the repository URL

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: For a monorepo, the component whose latest release to return (e.g. `op-node`)

parameters.name: prerelease
parameters.description: true = the newest release even if it is a prerelease

get.description: Client registry from chains-client-feed: repositories and name-only clients, filtered by text, kind or chain.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Substring of the repo slug or any client name

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Repository kind (e.g. execution, consensus, node)

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID

get.description: One client repository with every network it serves (reverse lookup), its latest release and latest fork.
Clients known to serve a chain, each with the kinds it plays there, its latest release and latest fork.

parameters.name: chainId
parameters.description: Chain ID

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Only this provider id (e.g. "infura", "quicknode")

post.description: Report wrong or misattributed information (an upgrade linked to the wrong incident, a stale version, a mis-mapped chain). Stored in memory (last 1000) with a best-effort file mirror; no IP or user-agent is recorded.

errorMessage.enum: Field "kind" must be one of: upgrade, incident, provider, forum, news, chain, other

refId.description: Identifier of the item being reported (incident id, upgrade/incident title, chain id…)

errorMessage.enum: Field "reason" must be one of: wrong_chain, wrong_version, wrong_time, not_related, misclassified, outdated, other

page.description: Dashboard view the report came from

get.description: Slim projection of all chains (id, name, tags, relations, RPC count) plus L2BEAT headline data. Designed for dashboards; a fraction of the size of /export. Supports ETag revalidation (If-None-Match → 304).

Assistant availability probe. Reports whether the chat assistant is configured, which model backs it, whether the LLM server is currently reachable (checked live, cached ~30s; null when disabled), and the per-request time budget actually in effect — useful to verify a config rollout landed.

post.description: Chat with the assistant about chains, endpoints, scaling, relations, live incidents, and forum news. Stateless: send the full conversation each turn; the assistant may reply with a clarifying question (e.g. mainnet vs testnet) — answer it in a follow-up message. Fast answers return 200 directly; slow LLM runs return 202 with a job id to poll at GET /assistant/chat/:jobId (keeps every request under reverse-proxy timeouts).

errorMessage.minLength: Message content must not be empty
errorMessage.maxLength: Message content too long. Max length: 4000

errorMessage.minItems: At least one message is required

get.description: Poll an async assistant job started by POST /assistant/chat (202 response). Returns status running/done/error; done responses carry the full chat result. Finished jobs expire after ~10 minutes.
